### Bible Pathways 2/13/2004
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-2-or-13-or-2004-1243538.html
Passage: Numbers 3:4
Points:
- Great spiritual privilege and recognized leadership do not shield anyone from the consequences of disobeying God.
- Offering unauthorized fire demonstrated a dangerous disregard for God's explicit commands regarding holy worship.
- Popularity, position, or religious status will never excuse disobedience in God's eyes.
- Engaging in ministry or church life without sincere submission to Christ is hypocrisy.
- Believers cannot treat obedience as optional or rationalize setting aside portions of God's Word.
